entries.title: 只用已核实事实写客户回复
entries.summary: 按给定事实写 80 词内的客户回复，价格和条件不改、不做承诺，缺失信息单独列出。
entries.prompt: Draft a customer reply under 80 words using only these approved facts: [facts]. Keep the price, limits and conditions unchanged. Do not promise availability or results. List missing details separately. Draft only; do not send.
entries.author: cr8trhq

entries.title: 只指出最该删的3句
entries.summary: 改文案前不让 AI 通篇润色，而是只挑出最该删的 3 句并说明原因，删不删由自己决定。
entries.prompt: 别改写，只指出最该删的3句，各用一句话说明原因。删不删由你定。
entries.author: zrqgood9068

entries.title: 会议纪要加跟进邮件
entries.summary: 从会议笔记提取最多 5 个行动项（含负责人和截止日期）、一句话总结和两行跟进邮件。
entries.prompt: 'Extract up to 5 action items with owner & due date; 1-line summary; 2-line follow-up email. Keep it concise.'
entries.author: robertcodesai

entries.title: 学生 LinkedIn 简介
entries.summary: 按年龄、学科、活动和目标专业填空，生成四段式、220 词内的学生 LinkedIn About。
entries.prompt: "I am a [age]-year-old [Board] student at [school] in [city]. Key subjects: [list]. Passionate about [field]. Key activities: [list 3-4]. Target: [field] at [university type] for Fall [year]. Write a LinkedIn About in 4 paragraphs: hook, evidence, context, aspiration. Under 220 words. Sound like an ambitious teenager, not a corporate executive."
entries.author: studentprofiler

entries.title: 压缩三成并标出可跳过的句子
entries.summary: 把文本缩短约三成并保留全部事实，标出忙碌读者会跳过的句子，只给出压缩后的版本。
entries.prompt: Rewrite this to be 30% shorter, keep every fact, and flag any sentence a busy reader would skip. Then give me the tightened version only.
entries.author: NeyronixAI
